fichas.title: Hospital administration, records, and library
fichas.summary: Hospital administration includes patient-facing offices near the main entrance and internal business offices, with conference and meeting rooms. Records storage should be accessible to working areas where possible; mobile shelving can reduce storage space. Medical libraries should provide open shelving and reading tables with lamps. The Community Hospital, Herdecke/Ruhr, is captioned as having 192 beds.

fichas.title: Hospital main entrance, services, and social facilities
fichas.summary: The main entrance should be recognizable and accessible to vehicle traffic, taxis, patients, and visitors. The entrance hall functions as a waiting and orientation space that separates different traffic flows. Reception may handle telephone calls and post; a nearby cafeteria serves visitors and patients. The page also describes a non-denominational chapel or prayer room with adjoining support spaces and offices for chaplains and social workers.
